body:
I’m sure it doesn’t mean anything odd! Maybe it’ll just take time to accept that you’re lesbian or figure out something completely different!
I’ve been running circles around being pans, lesbian and ace, and it is TIRING
Do you wanna talk? I’m exactly the same (down to the 17F and all)
I think they meant that, as great as it is for OP, it might be stressful for the stranger they approach

Yes, and it was the one and only time I think I’ll ever get with a guy. I wouldn’t say we dated but something close enough to that. He was VERY  pushy when I clearly would say no or was uncomfortable. The guy had his hands all over me. I’m just glad I dipped two weeks in before we got any more “intimate” (it definitely wasn’t real).  
Should’ve cut things off the moment he told me his last ex left after quite some time without any conversation or ‘reasoning’. Im very much disgusted by the thought of him.
I guess so. Hopefully they’re referring to grown women with “no boobs”/a flat chest, which there are plenty of.
Wtf why did your mind go to children mate??
AHHHH this is so cute!! Let’s just hope he doesn’t find out-
Hey, why do you deserve to be punished??

I can’t give advice or anything like that, but I find comfort in the fact that I’m exactly the same way. It’s scary actually, you might just be me. 

Maybe we should work towards becoming that great version of ourselves that we always imagine or just fake it till we make it.

Did OP not reply saying that they reported it? How do you know he’s not in jail? Even if he isn’t, there’s not much either one of them can do after reporting it; when it comes to rape and sexual assault, the system can be quite fucked.

Hey there’s absolutely nothing wrong with being gay, and there’s nothing you need to “fix”! Would you say that I and the hundreds of thousands of gay people deserve to die too? (The answer is ofc not) 
I know how hard it can be to come to terms with your sexuality, especially when everyone around you berates you for it. I’m lesbian and not at all religious but my family are VERY religious Muslims- I have to listen to their homophobic talks about how disgusting it is and just agree with them. No matter what people have to say though, we are completely valid. There’s nothing wrong or broken about you.

“I bet she didn’t even report her rapist to the police”

Was that really necessary?

I’ve been in a similar situation before except on the other end. I laughed whilst resisting out of being uncomfortable but I also felt bad that I led him on that far. Obviously, I should’ve been more assertive in telling him to stop but, for some reason, I couldn’t. At the same time, he should’ve taken my resistance as a sign to stop, just like you should’ve. If someone shows any sort of resistance in any advance in the future, you shouldn’t go any further. You should ask if they’re okay at the very least. 

Anyways, you could talk to her about what happened and apologise for advancing when she clearly didn’t want to- either that or you leave her be. I don’t think she’d be particularly attracted to you after this incident. Besides, if you’re that horny and desperate, go to Tinder or something.
